race.description: Boxing Day Races @ Ballina Mdn Plate
race.comment: THE MINSTREL BOY (5) wears some blinkers now and that might be what he needs to get that win. He will be having the first run for the new stable but did start in the betting all his runs down south. Has to be a factor despite the barrier. TO'O (9) was so much better second up. He had to come from way back again but really hit the line. The betting suggested he would too. TESTY NIC (4) has not done much to date. At least he has a soft barrier so he can get to whichever part of the track he needs. QUI ROUGE (12) finished seventh last start, beaten 3 lengths at Port Macquarie over 1200m. Has claims on best.
